The York University invites applications from PhD degree holders for VISTA Distinguished Post-Doctoral Fellowship 2021. The fellowship aims to support distinguished researchers from other national or international institutions to carry out postdoctoral research under the supervision of a VISTA core member that is aligned with the VISTA (Vision: Science to Applications) program.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Hold a PhD degree from a national or international institution
Be doing postdoctoral research which is aligned with the VISTA program under the supervision of VISTA core member
Provide evidence of excellence in their field
The selected scholars will receive the following benefits:
Minimum CAD 70,000 per annum for up to 2 years
A one-page summary of the proposed research
Voluntary self-identification survey in the specified format
Postdoctoral Supervisor Form in the specified format
: Referees do not include the proposed supervisor. The proposed supervisor may opt to submit a maximum of 5 pages letter of reference.
Follow the following steps to apply:
Find a VISTA Core Member as a supervisor.
Email the completed application form along with required documents to applyvista@york.ca.
The letters of support should be sent directly from referees to applyvista@yorku.ca.
The fellows will be selected on the basis of -
Fit with the goals of the VISTA program
The distinguished fellows have to meet additional standards of excellence to receive the fellowship.
The applicants have to accept or decline the offer made within 21 days from the date of the offer.
The evidence of excellence may include best paper awards, high impact venues, or other measures of achievement and recognition.
